paper_method: Fetched from Drive by the main agent in two copies (byte-identical), converted by the converter of phases 1 to 2b (md_to_plain), ingested with scripts/ingest_drive_doc.py as a NEW document appended after the sage's existing document(s); the existing documents and their English and Russian files are not changed. The English and Russian of the new document only are line-aligned translations made through scripts/translate_lines/tx_api.py with TX_RES (a scratch folder holding only the new document) and appended by tx_append.py.
